top_choice_rationale: P004 recognizes a mature, foundational and extensively used integration of firm heterogeneity and selection into trade analysis. Melitz is indispensable to the canonical framework, and the bounded citation makes the strongest available case despite a real uncertainty over the appropriate complementary recipients.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the profile. I have co-authored with committee colleague John Hassler, but this does not concern proposed laureates.
